narrative.overview: The Gallery Archive design system embodies an exhibition space: clean, intentional, and highly structured. It frames technical expertise with editorial discipline, allowing work details to stand out without competing with decorative background elements. The system rejected standard AI SaaS tropes (cyan-on-dark neon grids, generic gradient overlays, and glassmorphism) in favor of high-contrast typography, sharp borders, and generous whitespace.
keyCharacteristics: Sharp Corners Only: Circular styling is reserved exclusively for interactive elements. All primary containers, borders, and main buttons utilize strict 0px radii.
Editorial Contrast: Deep, deliberate weight and size scales create immediate typographic focus.
Organic Deceleration: Transitions and entry reveals employ smooth exponential curves to reinforce the high-end feel.

rules.name: The Accent Restraint Rule
rules.body: The primary Archive Indigo accent must occupy no more than 10% of any viewport. Its purpose is to guide focus, not to saturate the interface.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Monochromatic surfaces (pure black #000 or pure white #fff) are prohibited. All neutrals are subtly warm-tinted to avoid looking artificial or clinical.

rules.name: The Balance & Pretty Rule
rules.body: Display sizes (h1 to h3) must apply text-wrap: balance to prevent awkward word wraps. Body text blocks must use text-wrap: pretty to reduce typographic orphans.

rules.name: The Border-Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is created through layout structure, sharp contrast steps, and 1px borders, never through drop shadows. If an element appears raised, it should be marked by an active border color shift or an OKLCH background tint elevation.

dos: Do align large numbers and headings with asymmetrical margins to create an editorial grid flow.
Do use native dialog elements or relative positioning rather than z-index overrides.
Do enforce a 65ch line length limit on all body text blocks.
Do wrap display titles in text-wrap: balance.
donts: Don't add box-shadows to buttons or cards. Keep all elevation flat and tactile.
Don't use cyan-to-purple gradients, floating decorative grids, or neon accents on dark backgrounds.
Don't use side-stripe borders (e.g. border-left-4 as an accent) on cards, callouts, or layout sections.
Don't use card corners exceeding 0px on main card components (keep cards, sections, and inputs sharp).
